headline: Silgo Retail confirms SEBI-compliant share dematerialization for Q2 FY27
hook: Silgo Retail completes mandatory share dematerialization
summary: Silgo Retail has officially confirmed the completion of its share dematerialization process in compliance with SEBI regulations for the second quarter of FY2026-27. This process converts physical share certificates into electronic format, facilitating easier trading and settlement on stock exchanges. The move ensures the company remains aligned with current market transparency and regulatory standards.
why_it_matters: Standard regulatory compliance with no direct impact on stock price.

headline: Silgo Retail releases voting results from annual general meeting
hook: Silgo Retail concludes annual shareholder meeting
summary: Silgo Retail Limited held its Annual General Meeting on September 29, 2026. The company has officially submitted the voting results and meeting outcomes to the NSE. This filing confirms the completion of the mandatory annual corporate governance process for the company.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price.
